description.value: Zaika Tastes of India is an Abbotsford Indian restaurant offering a broad menu of North Indian classics, tandoor specialties, street food snacks, and Indo-Chinese dishes. The kitchen caters to a wide range of dietary needs, with vegetarian and gluten-free items clearly marked throughout the menu. Cyclists passing through the Fraser Valley will find it a substantial hot-meal stop with plenty of carb-friendly options like naan, roti, and rice-based dishes.
